skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the necessity of state intervention through policy, differentiate between policy and other management tools, and grasp the role of policy analysis in the policy-making process.
Identify and formulate policy options, select the best policy alternatives, and understand the implementation and monitoring of policies.
Analyze economic and social conditions to identify policy issues, evaluate current policies, and assess their impact.
Develop research skills, critical thinking, and the ability to analyze and solve policy problems.
Work effectively in teams, communicate ideas clearly, and present findings confidently.
Adhere to ethical standards and professional responsibilities in policy analysis and implementation.
